## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can MPK Mahal hold?
The main hall holds 1,200 guests with 800 seated; the mini hall holds 200 with 120 seated.

### Where is MPK Mahal?
100 Feet Road, No. 39, 1st Street, Ashok Nagar, Chennai 600 083.

### What facilities does MPK Mahal have?
Pillar-less banquet halls, Central A/C, Mini hall, Bride & groom rooms, Lockers, 24/7 CCTV & security, Free Wi-Fi, Pure veg, vegan & Jain catering, Live counters, Theme decor, DJ & live music, Projectors & screens.

### Do you provide catering?
Yes. We serve pure vegetarian, vegan and Jain food, from South Indian meals to multi-cuisine menus and live counters.

### Can we hold a small function?
Yes, the mini hall suits engagements, birthdays, meetings and family functions.

### How do I book MPK Mahal?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 98849 99394.
